other_conditions: Applicant must be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme, 1952 or an exempted establishment under Section 17 of the Act
Applicant's monthly pay must not exceed ₹15,000 (unless contributing an additional 1.16% above this limit)
Applicant must have at least 10 years of eligible service for pension benefits
Applicant must have contributed to the Employees' Pension Fund
For early pension, applicant must opt between ages 50 and 58
For family pension, applicant must be the spouse or child of a deceased member and provide proof of relationship and death; the deceased must have contributed for at least one month
Post‑selection, applicant must submit required documents for verification and follow EPFO guidelines for pension disbursement
International workers are eligible under specific social security agreements
benefits_summary: Provides superannuation, early, and family pensions to eligible employees after retirement, disability, or death.
